sources.entry: Kittl - AI-powered graphic design tool with text-to-image and logo generation. #freemium

summary.name: Kittl
summary.one_liner: Kittl is an AI-first design platform for creators and businesses that combines multiple image and video generation models with editing tools, mockups, and curated assets for branding and product visuals.
use_cases: produce product visuals for online listings
scale marketing content without a design team
generate AI images and short videos
summary.what_it_does: The page lists access to image and video generation models from OpenAI (ChatGPT Image 2, ChatGPT Image 1HD, GPT Alpha, DALL·E 3), Google (Veo 3.1, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro 4K), ByteDance (Seedance 2.0, Seedream models), Ideogram, Recraft, Black Forest Labs (Flux models), and Kling (Kling Video 3.0 Pro). It says it offers pro editing tools, mockups, and curated assets. The stated focus is producing branding and product visuals from an idea to a listing. The page does not detail specific editing features beyond these general descriptions.
notable: Single platform with access to many third-party AI models (OpenAI, Google, ByteDance, Ideogram, Recraft, Black Forest Labs, Kling)
Covers both image generation and video generation
Includes mockups and curated assets alongside AI generation
caveats: Free tier is described only as 'free to start'; paid plan details are not on the page
Platform availability beyond the web is not stated
